Class Player

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am31.am31.modelPackage.playerFolder.Player
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameObservable
public class Player extends Object implements GameObservable
Represents a player in a game of Mesos. Game event resolution (sustenance, hunt, ritual, end-of-turn, end-game) is handled by a set of pluggable handlers that building cards can extend via the decorator pattern.

    • hasBonusDraw

      public boolean hasBonusDraw()
      Since there is only one building that awards a bonus draw, and it is always a bonus draw from upper line, the only information needed is if the player has the bonus draw. Only one player can have this bonus at the same time.
      Returns:
      true if the player has a bonus draw for the BONUS_DRAWING_PHASE

    • addBonusDraw

      public void addBonusDraw()
      Permanently grants this player the bonus draw ability. Called once when the player acquires the bonus-draw building card.
